contract_completeness: Every required field has an explicit JSON type, shape, defining equation or predicate, and canonicalization rule.

nullspace_orthogonality.canonicalization: basis/free-column order from task rules; every value is zero
nullspace_orthogonality.definition: dot products of control with canonical nullspace basis vectors

rational_encoding: reduced string n or n/d; denominator positive
representation_conventions: Indices are zero-based unless a mathematical exponent or degree is explicitly named. Matrices are row-major; nested tensor array order is stated per task.

A rational scalar is a reduced JSON string "n" or "n/d" with positive denominator. JSON integers are used only where the field contract says integer. Floats, decimal approximations, NaN and infinity are invalid.
The submission object has exactly required_fields, with no additional keys. Nested objects likewise use exactly the named keys.
task_rules: Let n=len(target), h=horizon and b be the only column of B. Define the reachability matrix C_h=[A^(h-1)b, A^(h-2)b, ..., b] in input-time order and G=C_h C_h^T.
The submitted control is the unique minimizer of sum_k u_k^2 subject to C_h u=target; the dual convention is G y=target and u=C_h^T y.

The canonical nullspace basis is obtained from RREF(C_h): free columns increase, each basis vector has its own free coordinate 1, other free coordinates 0, and pivot coordinates from the RREF equations.
